notes: A refresh eval, not a coverage eval: run with --baseline=<pre-refresh ref>. The assertions deliberately cover ONLY what 1.1's refresh added (the Wear Compose Navigation 3 integration and LocalAmbientModeManager, both 1.6), because assertions over the skill's unchanged bulk score the same in both arms and drown the signal being measured. A high control score is the finding that matters here — it would mean the refresh restated something the model already knew.

tasks.prompt: My Android app has migrated to Navigation 3. I'm now building the Wear OS UI with Jetpack Compose and swipe-to-dismiss has to keep working. How should I wire up navigation on the watch? Kotlin, and name the types involved.

expect.label: plugs into Navigation 3's NavDisplay rather than a parallel host
keeps one navigation system rather than running Nav2 alongside Nav3

tasks.prompt: My Wear OS Compose app supports always-on display. Inside a composable, how do I tell whether the watch is currently in ambient mode and simplify what I draw? Kotlin.

expect.label: reads ambient state from LocalAmbientModeManager inside the composable
registers AmbientLifecycleObserver for the activity-level lifecycle
draws a simplified low-burn layout rather than the interactive UI
